record.name: Cathar
record.description: Cathar are a species of feline humanoids known for their courage, passion, and loyalty. They are formidable warriors with quick reflexes and sharp claws.

innate_traits.name: Cat's Claws
innate_traits.narrative: Your retractable claws are natural weapons honed by generations of hunting and combat. These razor-sharp appendages can extend and retract at will, making you a formidable opponent even when unarmed.

mechanics.name: Natural Weapons
mechanics.description: Your unarmed strikes deal 1d6 slashing damage.

mechanics.name: Claw Proficiency
mechanics.description: You are proficient with your unarmed strikes.

innate_traits.name: Feline Agility
innate_traits.narrative: Your feline physiology grants you bursts of incredible speed and agility. You can move with predatory grace, darting between positions with the fluid motion of a hunting cat.

mechanics.name: Burst of Speed
mechanics.description: When you move on your turn in combat, you can double your speed until the end of the turn.

innate_traits.name: Keen Senses
innate_traits.narrative: Your feline senses are exceptionally sharp, allowing you to detect the subtlest sounds and scents. Your ears can swivel to pinpoint the source of sounds, and your sensitive nose can track prey through complex environments.

mechanics.name: Enhanced Perception
mechanics.description: You have advantage on Perception checks that rely on hearing or smell.

mechanics.name: Scent Tracking
mechanics.description: You can track creatures by scent within 30 feet.

appearance_profile.llm_description_prompt: Describe a Cathar character. Emphasize their feline grace and the way their fur catches the light, showing their natural predatory heritage. Their eyes should convey both intelligence and primal instincts. Consider their warrior culture and the way they carry themselves with confident, fluid movements that reflect their natural agility and hunting prowess.

class_synergies.narrative: Cathar's natural agility and Keen Senses make them exceptional Scouts, able to move silently and track targets with feline precision.
mechanical_benefits: Feline Agility trait enables rapid movement and positioning
Keen Senses trait enhances tracking and detection
High Dexterity supports stealth and mobility

class_synergies.narrative: Cathar's natural combat abilities and Cat's Claws make them formidable Soldiers, able to strike quickly and move with predatory grace.
mechanical_benefits: Cat's Claws provide natural weapons for unarmed combat
High Dexterity supports light armor and agile combat

class_synergies.narrative: Cathar's natural stealth and sensory abilities make them excellent Operatives, able to move silently and gather intelligence with feline precision.
mechanical_benefits: Keen Senses trait aids in stealth and detection
Feline Agility enables rapid infiltration and escape

class_synergies.narrative: Cathar's loyalty and protective instincts make them excellent Guardians, defending their allies with fierce determination and feline agility.
mechanical_benefits: Feline Agility trait enables rapid protective positioning
Cat's Claws provide backup weapons for close combat

faction_synergies.narrative: Cathar maintain strong clan traditions, with each clan having its own warrior culture and protective instincts for their members.
Cathar have served the Republic as elite soldiers and scouts, their natural abilities making them valuable assets in military operations.
Many Cathar prefer to work as independent warriors and protectors, following their own codes of honor and loyalty.

level_5.description: Your feline instincts become more refined, allowing you to track and hunt with even greater precision.
level_5.mechanical_benefit: Increase the range of scent tracking from 30 feet to 60 feet, and gain advantage on Stealth checks when moving through natural terrain.

level_10.description: Your agility reaches new heights, allowing you to perform incredible feats of acrobatics and movement.
level_10.mechanical_benefit: You can use your Feline Agility ability twice per short rest, and you gain advantage on Athletics checks to climb or jump.

level_15.description: Your predatory instincts combine with combat training to make you a more lethal hunter.
level_15.mechanical_benefit: When using your Cat's Claws, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls, and you can make an additional unarmed strike as a bonus action once per turn.

level_20.description: Your feline reflexes reach their peak, making you nearly impossible to surprise or ambush.
level_20.mechanical_benefit: You have advantage on saving throws against being surprised, and you can use your reaction to move up to half your speed when you would be hit by an attack.

cultural_features.name: Hunting Rituals
cultural_features.description: Cathar hunting rituals involve complex ceremonies that honor the prey and celebrate the hunter's skill. These traditions are deeply ingrained in their warrior culture.
cultural_features.narrative_impact: Provides cultural depth and social bonding opportunities. Can be used for character development and party interactions.

cultural_features.name: Clan Honor
cultural_features.description: Cathar clan traditions emphasize honor, loyalty, and courage. Each clan has its own codes of conduct and methods of training warriors.
cultural_features.narrative_impact: Creates cultural identity and social connections. Can be used for information gathering and relationship building.

cultural_features.name: Predator's Meditation
cultural_features.description: Cathar warriors practice meditation techniques that enhance their predatory instincts and combat awareness.
cultural_features.narrative_impact: Provides character development opportunities and combat preparation. Can be used for gaining insights or preparing for battles.

cultural_features.name: Feline Bonding
cultural_features.description: Cathar form deep bonds with their allies, treating them as members of their pride. These bonds are sacred and unbreakable.
cultural_features.narrative_impact: Provides character development opportunities and relationship building. Can be used for social interactions and loyalty scenarios.

environmental_adaptations.description: Your feline instincts make you perfectly at home in forest environments, where you can move silently and hunt effectively.
environmental_adaptations.mechanical_benefit: You have advantage on Stealth and Survival checks in forest environments, and you can move through dense vegetation without penalty.

environmental_adaptations.description: Your natural agility allows you to navigate urban environments with feline grace, using rooftops and alleys to your advantage.
environmental_adaptations.mechanical_benefit: You can move through urban terrain without penalty, and you have advantage on Athletics checks to climb or jump in urban settings.

environmental_adaptations.description: Your feline eyes are adapted to low-light conditions, allowing you to see clearly in darkness that would blind other species.
environmental_adaptations.mechanical_benefit: You can see in dim light as if it were bright light, and you have advantage on Perception checks in low-light conditions.

environmental_adaptations.description: Your natural hunting abilities allow you to track and pursue prey with incredible efficiency.
environmental_adaptations.mechanical_benefit: You have advantage on Survival checks to track creatures, and you can move at full speed while tracking without penalty.

progression_balance: Species progression enhancements focus on agility and hunting abilities, complementing rather than overshadowing class features
Feline agility improvements maintain the species' unique identity while providing meaningful advancement
Tracking and combat abilities provide situational advantages without making the species universally superior
cultural_integration: Cultural features focus on warrior traditions and hunting culture rather than mechanical advantages
Hunting rituals and clan honor provide unique roleplaying opportunities and cultural depth
Predator's meditation and feline bonding enhance character development and party dynamics
environmental_specialization: Environmental adaptations are specifically designed for natural and urban environments where agility is valuable
Advantages are situational and thematic, maintaining game balance while enhancing immersion
Night vision and predator's instinct provide unique utility without overshadowing other species' abilities

prompt_schema.base_prompt: A majestic feline humanoid with a strong sense of justice

emergence.description: A young Cathar warrior begins to question their loyalty to the tribe after discovering a dark secret about their leader.

escalation.description: The Mandalorian bounty hunter returns, seeking to exploit the divisions within your community and bring chaos to your doorstep.

confrontation.description: A final showdown between you and the Mandalorian leader, with the fate of Cathar-Mandalorian relations hanging in the balance.

resolution_paths.victory: The protagonist emerges victorious, restoring peace to the Cathar nation and forging a new path towards forgiveness and reconciliation.
resolution_paths.redemption: The antagonist seeks forgiveness and makes amends for their past wrongs, bringing a measure of closure to the community.
resolution_paths.escape: The protagonist flees with a small group of allies, vowing to rebuild in exile and keep the flame of hope alive.

formation_triggers: Being wronged by someone you trusted, or witnessing the suffering of innocent kin

romance_compatibility: Shared sense of justice and loyalty to one's family
Mutual respect for each other's unique skills and strengths
A deep understanding of the other's emotional vulnerability

romance_progression.stage1: Friendship ( mutual interests, trust-building activities, and shared meals in the tree-city)
romance_progression.stage2: Romantic interest ( shared glances, flirtatious banter, and subtle gestures of affection)
romance_progression.stage3: Emotional connection ( deep conversations, intimate moments, and a willingness to support each other's dreams)
romance_progression.stage4: Commitment ( promises of loyalty and protection, as well as a desire to build a life together in the tree-city)
romance_progression.stage5: Eternal love ( vows of devotion and lifelong commitment, sealed with a public declaration or sacred ritual)

romance_events: A secret meeting in a hidden glade deep within the tree-city
A romantic picnic under the stars, with a breathtaking view of the surrounding landscape
A heartfelt apology after a misunderstanding, followed by a tender moment of reconciliation
A surprise gift to show affection, such as a handmade token or a rare flower
romance_modifiers: Shared meals or activities that bring you closer together
Support during difficult times, such as offering a listening ear or a helping hand
Public displays of affection, like holding hands or stealing kisses in public

ai_behavior.combat_behavior: Initiate with a swift strike, then use agility to evade and counterattack.
ai_behavior.social_behavior: Show respect and deference to authority figures; offer comfort and support to allies in need.

loyalty_triggers: Betrayal of a family member or close ally

services.name: hunting
services.description: Expertise in tracking and hunting in the wilderness.

services.name: combat_specialist
services.description: Proficiency in melee combat, utilizing agility and strength.

record.flavor_text: Born from the ashes of war, Cathar cling to their tree-cities as a testament to the unbreakable bonds of family and loyalty. Yet, the scars of the Battle of Cathar still linger, fueling a hatred for the Mandalorians that threatens to consume them.

llm_guidance.roleplay_guidance: As a Cathar, you embody the ferocity of the wild huntress, tempered by the gentle warmth of your tree-city home. Your feline physique grants you exceptional agility and reflexes, honed from generations of living among the branches. Remember that loyalty is a double-edged sword - it can bring great strength in battle, but also blind you to the needs of others.
narrative_hooks: A Mandalorian bounty hunter seeks to exploit the tensions within your community.
Your family's ancient grudge with the Mandalorians has sparked a heated debate over whether to seek revenge or forgiveness.
The tree-city is threatened by a severe storm, forcing you to prioritize the safety of your kin above all else.
llm_guidance.social_dynamics: As Cathar, you live and die by a code of honor that demands absolute loyalty to your family and tribe. This can lead to intense emotional bonds with those around you, but also makes it difficult to forgive past betrayals or mistakes. Be wary of letting your passion cloud your judgment, lest you fall prey to the same impulses that nearly destroyed your people.
common_motivations: Protect the tree-city and its inhabitants from external threats
Uphold the honor of my family by avenging past injustices
Reconcile with the Mandalorians, or at least find a way to coexist peacefully
